readmeExcerpt: This module is step 2 of the [Kafka-to-TxEventQ migration sample](../README.md). It keeps Oracle AI Database Transactional Event Queues as the transport and adds OSON serialization for `WeatherEvent` messages using the Oracle JSON libraries.
highlights: Oracle AI Database Free running on localhost:1521
